slides.headline: Yesterday, where we’re going. Today, how we get there.
notes: Open Day 2. Yesterday set the direction: functions, purpose, values, BHAG and 3HAG.
Today turns that into this year, this quarter and each leader’s priorities. Every number and priority gets an owner.

artwork.alt: Day 1, where we’re going, done: Functions, KFFM, Purpose, Values, BHAG and 3HAG. Day 2, how we get there: 1HAG (next), QHAG, Your priorities and Communication rhythm. By end of day: this year’s plan, this quarter’s plan and each leader’s priorities, all with owners.

slides.title: Share personal good news.
slides.headline: Share personal good news.
notes: Use a separate round. Each person shares personal good news in 5 to 10 seconds.

artwork.alt: Generic figures share good news around a table.

slides.title: What’s something about you that would surprise this team?
slides.headline: What’s something about you that would surprise this team?
notes: Coach goes first, then the CEO, then the team. Keep it light and quick.
This is the Sunday dinner question, adapted to leave no one out.

artwork.alt: A person opens a box and a green star pops out while two teammates react.

slides.title: What stayed with you from Day 1?
slides.headline: What stayed with you from Day 1?
notes: Invite one reflection from each person. Capture questions that affect today’s planning.

artwork.alt: A person sits with chin in hand, thinking, with a thought cloud above.

slides.title: Are we on track for what you came for?
slides.headline: Are we on track for what you came for?
notes: Read back the Day 1 answers to “What would make these 2 days valuable?” The team sorts each one. Coach-led and quick, not another round.
For anything at risk, name when you will address it today before moving on.

panels.heading: Not on today’s plan
panels.support: Decide now how we cover it.

slides.title: Today, let’s:
slides.headline: Today, let’s:
notes: Confirm agreement on how the team will work. Invite difficult facts and constructive disagreement.
Strong convictions, loosely held: argue your view fully, and change it when the facts change.
Disagree and commit: say where you disagree while everyone is in the room. Once the team decides, everyone backs the decision outside it.

panels.heading: No blame. No shame.
panels.support: Make it safe to speak honestly.

panels.heading: Disagree and commit
panels.support: Say it in the room, then back the decision.

slides.headline: Where we are in the cascade.
notes: Each level is built from the one above it and directs the one below.
Point to the 3HAG we finished yesterday, then to the 1HAG we build next.
